result.brief: 提出噪声耦合双分支反事实 rollout 框架，用于交互式视频世界模型的反事实生成、时空局部性度量与可验证奖励后训练。
result.reason: Formalizes counterfactual twin rollouts in interactive video world models with noise coupling, locality metrics, and verifiable rewards from simulator forking—directly advancing action-conditioned video world modeling.
